// Generated companion for a private drawer adaptation. No app-kit runtime required.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// Drawer contains presentation data and app-owned navigation. Presence and
// truthful online state, profile actions and destinations remain app concerns.
type Drawer struct {
	IDPrefix        string
	OpenLabel       string
	Heading         string
	CloseLabel      string
	Name            string
	Handle          string
	OnlineLabel     string
	MenuLabel       string
	ImageURL        string
	ImageAlt        string
	ImageDecorative bool
	Primary         *DrawerLink
	Secondary       *DrawerLink
	MenuLinks       []DrawerLink
	Details         []DrawerDetail
}

type DrawerLink struct {
	Label string
	URL   string
}

type DrawerDetail struct {
	Label string
	Text  string
	Kind  string
	Date  string
}

// NewDrawer validates and snapshots all caller-owned data before returning the
// source-styled component.
func NewDrawer(data Drawer) (templ.Component, error) {
	if err := validateDrawer(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	snapshot := data
	if data.Primary != nil {
		primary := *data.Primary
		snapshot.Primary = &primary
	}
	if data.Secondary != nil {
		secondary := *data.Secondary
		snapshot.Secondary = &secondary
	}
	snapshot.MenuLinks = append([]DrawerLink(nil), data.MenuLinks...)
	snapshot.Details = append([]DrawerDetail(nil), data.Details...)
	return guardedDrawer(drawer(snapshot)), nil
}

func validateDrawer(data Drawer) error {
	if !drawerIDPrefix(data.IDPrefix) {
		return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid IDPrefix")
	}
	for _, field := range []struct {
		name  string
		value string
	}{
		{"OpenLabel", data.OpenLabel}, {"Heading", data.Heading},
		{"CloseLabel", data.CloseLabel}, {"Name", data.Name},
		{"MenuLabel", data.MenuLabel},
	} {
		if !drawerText(field.value, 256) {
			return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid %s", field.name)
		}
	}
	for _, field := range []struct{ name, value string }{
		{"Handle", data.Handle}, {"OnlineLabel", data.OnlineLabel},
	} {
		if field.value != "" && !drawerText(field.value, 256) {
			return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid %s", field.name)
		}
	}
	if !drawerLinkURL(data.ImageURL) {
		return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid ImageURL")
	}
	if data.ImageDecorative {
		if data.ImageAlt != "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("drawer: decorative image alt must be empty")
		}
	} else if !drawerText(data.ImageAlt, 512) {
		return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid ImageAlt")
	}
	for _, field := range []struct {
		name string
		link *DrawerLink
	}{
		{"Primary", data.Primary},
		{"Secondary", data.Secondary},
	} {
		name, link := field.name, field.link
		if link != nil && (!drawerText(link.Label, 256) || !drawerLinkURL(link.URL)) {
			return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid %s", name)
		}
	}
	if len(data.MenuLinks) > 12 {
		return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid MenuLinks")
	}
	for _, link := range data.MenuLinks {
		if !drawerText(link.Label, 256) || !drawerLinkURL(link.URL) {
			return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid menu link")
		}
	}
	if len(data.Details) > 12 {
		return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid Details")
	}
	for _, detail := range data.Details {
		if !drawerText(detail.Label, 256) || !drawerText(detail.Text, 4096) {
			return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid detail")
		}
		switch detail.Kind {
		case "date":
			parsed, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", detail.Date)
			if err != nil || parsed.Year() < 1 || parsed.Format("2006-01-02") != detail.Date {
				return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid detail date")
			}
		case "text", "paragraph":
			if detail.Date != "" {
				return fmt.Errorf("drawer: unexpected detail date")
			}
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("drawer: invalid detail kind")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func drawerIDPrefix(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 64 || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for i, b := range []byte(value) {
		if i == 0 {
			if b < 'A' || b > 'Z' && b < 'a' || b > 'z' {
				return false
			}
			continue
		}
		if b != '_' && b != '-' && (b < 'A' || b > 'Z') && (b < 'a' || b > 'z') && (b < '0' || b > '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func drawerText(value string, limit int) bool {
	if len(value) > limit || strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func drawerLinkURL(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 2048 || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value || !utf8.ValidString(value) || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\\ ") || drawerHasControl(value) {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
	if err != nil || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) || strings.Contains(decoded, "\\") || drawerHasControl(decoded) {
		return false
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(value)
	if err != nil || u.User != nil || u.Opaque != "" {
		return false
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") {
		return !strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") && !strings.HasPrefix(decoded, "//") && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == ""
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "https://") || u.Scheme != "https" || u.Hostname() == "" || strings.HasSuffix(u.Host, ":") || strings.ContainsAny(u.Host, "% ") {
		return false
	}
	if port := u.Port(); port != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 16)
		if err != nil || n == 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func drawerHasControl(value string) bool {
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func guardedDrawer(component templ.Component) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		default:
			return component.Render(ctx, w)
		}
	})
}
